claims.claim: UK used Canon EOS 600D Digital Camera very neat and sharp.
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies the readable model as Canon EOS 700D (photo 2), not 600D. Neat/sharp condition is not verifiable from the provided observations.
Canon branding is visible on the camera body (photos 0-2).

risks.risk: Wrong model / mismatch between what seller says and what is shown (600D vs 700D). This affects compatibility and resale value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo showing the model name on the camera body (e.g., 'EOS 700D' or 'EOS 600D') and the serial/label area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case mismatch (treat as not matching seller’s stated model) and assume lower resale value.

risks.risk: Functional condition is unknown (shutter, autofocus, buttons/ports, sensor health). Visible appearance may hide faults.
risks.proof: A short video test: power on, autofocus on a moving subject, take a photo, and show the image on the screen; also show live view focusing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / potentially faulty (worst case: 'as-is, may need service').

risks.risk: Battery/charger and accessories may be missing; this can prevent use or increase buyer cost.
risks.proof: Photos showing included items laid out: battery, charger, USB cable, memory card (if any), lens caps, strap, and any manuals/box.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing essentials (no battery/charger and no memory card).

risks.risk: Lens condition issues not fully shown (fungus, haze, scratches, separation). The other lens’s exact model and condition are unclear.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of both lenses: front and rear elements at an angle to show haze/fungus; also a photo of lens model markings (for the second lens).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming the second lens may be lower quality or needs cleaning/repair.

risks.risk: Physical damage (dents/scratches/cracks) not fully verifiable from the witness notes.
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of the camera body corners, mount area, screen edges, and lens barrels for scratches/dents/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic condition consistent with used gear.

risks.risk: Potential theft/lock status or warranty/receipt absence (if applicable).
risks.proof: Provide receipt/warranty (if any) and a photo of the serial number label; confirm no lock/blacklist status if the seller can.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no proof of ownership/warranty (worst case: buyer bears risk).

proof_requests: Confirm the exact camera model with a close-up photo of the model label on the body (EOS 700D vs EOS 600D).
Show a working test video: power on, autofocus/live view, and a taken photo displayed on the screen.
List and photograph all included items: battery, charger, memory card (if any), cables, lens caps, hood, manuals/box.
Provide close-up photos of both lenses’ front and rear elements to check for fungus/haze/scratches, plus the exact model marking for the second lens.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item as a Canon DSLR with an EFS 18-55mm lens and a readable EOS 700D on one unit, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition. Seller’s '600D' claim is contradicted by the readable model, and functionality/accessories are unverified, so pricing should assume the worst until tested.
